scene.title: Dijkstra's shortest‑path walk‑through
scene.summary: Step‑by‑step visual of Dijkstra on a 4‑node weighted graph, showing tentative distances and visited nodes.

beats.title: Graph and initial distances
beats.narration: We show the graph and set all distances to ∞, then give the source A distance 0.

beats.title: Visit source A
beats.narration: Node A is now visited; its distance is final.

beats.title: Relax A’s neighbours
beats.narration: Examine edges A‑B (1) and A‑C (4) and update their tentative distances.

beats.title: Pick next node B
beats.narration: The smallest tentative distance is B=1, so we visit B and relax its edges.

beats.title: Visit C and improve D
beats.narration: Next smallest is C=3; visiting C gives a shorter path to D via C.

beats.title: All nodes visited
beats.narration: All nodes are visited; final shortest distances are A=0, B=1, C=3, D=4.
